data.name: Hadaf
data.gender_notes: Hadaf is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root ‘HD’ which means ‘to aim’ or ‘to target’. In Islamic history, a Hadaf was a target or a goal for which a Muslim would strive, such as seeking knowledge, performing good deeds or working towards entering Paradise. This name embodies the spirit of ambition, determination and focus. The name Hadaf carries the meaning “Target, Goal, Aim” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hadaf usually hope their child will grow to embody target, goal, aim and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes striving towards a worthy goal in life
data.etymology: Hadaf belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Target, Goal, Aim.”
